text: EtaSign is an option for SFAD, GFAD, CFAD and other objects representing propagators. It specifies the default sign of the i \eta prescription in the propagators, e.g. for standard Feynman propagators the value 1 corresponds to \(\frac{1}{p^2-m^2 + i \eta}\), while the value -1 sets \frac{1}{p^2-m^2 - i \eta}.
